meta.niche: Data center colocation, hybrid IT infrastructure, cloud and managed services

analysis.summary: TierPoint is refreshing sales pages. Digital Realty is publishing new AI-themed learning content, while others publish little. Few rivals speak to buyers directly.

points.text: TierPoint updated 16 older pages and published 2 new ones, so its push is a refresh of buying pages, not new education.
Digital Realty published 14 new pages and updated none, almost all about AI, aimed at learners and tied to cities and industries.
Rackspace, CoreSite and Expedient published 4, 3 and 1 pages. Those are weak signals, not strategies, and Flexential showed no activity.

TierPoint.play: Refreshes cloud, DR, security and data center service pages; adds one VMware VCF 9 explainer and one case study

Digital Realty.play: Publishes AI infrastructure research, case studies and city pages to position as the AI-ready platform

Flexential.play: No new or updated pages in the last 30 days; no content to read

Rackspace Technology.play: Small set of healthcare and AI sovereignty opinion pieces plus one migration case study

CoreSite.play: Three explainers on colocation, hybrid IT for AI and operations support

Expedient.play: One webinar page on Nutanix multi-tenant cloud; too small to call a strategy

shared.title: AI infrastructure messaging
shared.text: Digital Realty (many pages), Rackspace (AI sovereignty) and CoreSite (AI workloads) all tie AI to infrastructure. TierPoint's new content has little AI focus.

shared.title: Education over sales pages
shared.text: Digital Realty, Rackspace and CoreSite aim most new pages at learners, while TierPoint's pages mostly target buyers. TierPoint has little top-of-funnel content in this window.

gaps.title: AI-ready colocation guides
gaps.text: Only Digital Realty publishes AI infrastructure at volume and CoreSite has one page. TierPoint could own AI on hybrid and managed infrastructure for mid-market buyers.

gaps.title: VMware migration decision content
gaps.text: TierPoint has one VCF 9 explainer and no rival covers VMware. It could build a series of guides, comparisons and customer stories.

gaps.title: Sovereignty and compliance for regulated industries
gaps.text: Digital Realty and Rackspace cover sovereignty or healthcare in opinion pieces. TierPoint could offer practical guides to resilience and compliance.
